what_happened: Claude Code updated itself from 2.1.301 to 2.1.302 when the cloud container restarted at about 11:06 UTC. The version no longer matched the pin in athena.toml. The operator edited claude_version by hand to 2.1.302, as the owner had assigned. No job was involved, and the event is logged as an intervention.
cause: The pin and the runtime's self-update are not coordinated. The runtime can change its own version at any time, and a container restart now triggers it. The pin only changes through a job, and a job needs a working agent. The previous case produced only a standing instruction to bump the pin by hand. That left the same manual step in place, and it has now come up a third time with the owner assigning it to the operator. Nothing disables auto-update, detects drift before agents start, or offers a repin path that works without an agent.
prevention: Stop the self-update at its source: set the runtime's auto-update disable option (such as the DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER environment variable or the equivalent setting) in the container environment and the startup scripts, so a restart cannot change the version. Add a startup preflight that compares the installed version with the pin. On a mismatch it should either reinstall the pinned version or run a built-in agent-free `athena repin` command that edits the pin and logs the change as an intervention. This covers the whole class, because no restart or update can leave the pin and the runtime out of step with no way to recover.
proposed_request: Stop Claude Code from changing its own version behind Athena's back. Disable auto-update in the container environment and Athena's startup, so a cloud container restart leaves the installed version equal to claude_version in athena.toml. Add a preflight that runs before any agent starts and compares the installed version with the pin. On a mismatch it must stop with a clear message and offer an `athena repin` command that needs no agent, writes the new pin to athena.toml and logs an intervention. It is done when a simulated version change followed by a restart either leaves agents running on the pinned version or is repaired with `athena repin`, with no hand edit of athena.toml, and a test shows both paths.
